name: Jobicy
policy: Free public feed links to Jobicy; optional paid direct-application API; preserve requirements and check commercial reuse before launch

name: Remote OK
policy: Credit source and preserve required source backlink; archive freshness and test eligibility

name: Arbeitnow
policy: Review attribution and commercial display; many roles have geographic requirements

name: Remotive
policy: 24-hour delay; attribution and source links; no signup gate to view jobs; downstream syndication restrictions; clarify search-indexing use

name: Greenhouse employer boards
policy: Public access is not blanket republication consent; onboard approved employers; no application submission

name: Lever employer boards
policy: Discover approved employers separately; confirm reuse; link to original application

name: Ashby employer boards
policy: Confirm employer board and permitted republication; preserve location and salary context

name: USAJOBS
policy: Country citizenship and work authorization restrictions; not all work is remote

name: Freelancer
policy: Verify project-search scope credentials display retention and commercial permission before integration

name: Upwork
policy: API application required; maintain Upwork attribution; search aggregation and storage constraints need specific review

name: Taskrabbit
policy: Automated collection indexing and republication prohibited; seek partnership; local work is outside default online-only view

name: Fiverr
policy: Seller service listings are not buyer-funded open jobs; no approved live task feed established

name: Algora
policy: Confirm read access scope commercial display reward and claim status

name: GitHub approved repositories
policy: Only issuer-confirmed paid issues count; labels alone do not establish funding; verify terms rate limits and closures

name: HackerOne
policy: Do not assume reports API is public bounty feed; partner or directory approach; authorized program scope only

name: Immunefi
policy: Rewards conditional on valid in-scope reports; headline maximum is not expected earnings

name: Kaggle
policy: Include cash-prize competitions only; prize pool is not per-person pay; rules vary

name: Devpost
access_method: Public directory; organizer feeds by arrangement
policy: Seek organizer permission; filter online events with cash prizes; preserve deadlines and team eligibility

name: HeroX
policy: Check prize rules entrant geography and payout conditions; no bulk API confirmed

name: NASA Solve
policy: Not every challenge pays; preserve individual challenge cash eligibility and rules

name: Grants.gov
policy: Most grants are restricted funding not personal income; filter eligibility; check attachments separately

name: Simpler.Grants.gov
policy: Same underlying grant ecosystem; deduplicate against Grants.gov; use extracts/pagination rather than truncated broad search

name: SAM.gov
policy: Organizational tenders not instant gigs; distinguish solicitations from awards and sources-sought notices

name: EU TED
policy: Business procurement with regional and organizational eligibility; not all opportunities online-deliverable

name: Prolific
policy: Researcher API is not global participant task feed; personalized studies and waitlists; no login scraping

name: Respondent
policy: Screening and researcher selection apply; no public study aggregation API confirmed

name: UserTesting
policy: Personalized available tests inside contributor account; no public live task feed confirmed

name: User Interviews
policy: Confirm current participant route; public listing reuse not established

name: DataAnnotation
policy: Qualification and country restrictions; advertised maximum rates are not guaranteed earnings; private tasks excluded

name: Outlier
policy: Qualification country and task availability restrictions; no public global task feed established

name: Clickworker
policy: Worker-specific task access; customer task-management APIs do not imply worker-feed access

name: Direct employers clients and organizers
access_method: Permissioned submission API form or feed
policy: Verify poster and funding claims; moderate before publish; no automatic payout promise

name: Demand-backed business ideas
access_method: Approved client requests and original research
policy: Not paid listings; show observed buyer problem evidence validation cost and unknowns; no million-dollar income claim
